description_en: Verifies whether a phone number has been recycled and reassigned by a carrier. You can quickly check whether a number has been reassigned in a single request
description_zh: 验证手机号是否为运营商二次放号的号码，支持在一次请求中快速检验号码是否为二次放号
kebab_example: aliyun dytnsapi describe-phone-twice-tel-verify --auth-code Dd1r0004id --input-number 1390000000 --mask NORMAL --start-time 2018-01-01_00:00:00 --api-version 2020-02-17 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePhoneTwiceTelVerify

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code.

On the My Applications page in the China Number Service console (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply), obtain the authorization ID, which is the authorization code
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。

在号码百科控制台 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply)我的申请页面，获取授权ID即授权码
parameters.name: auth_code

parameters.help_en:
The phone number to query.

If Mask is set to NORMAL, this field is an 11-digit phone number.
If Mask is set to MD5, this field is a 32-character encrypted string.
If Mask is set to SHA256, this field is a 64-character encrypted string.

<notice>Letters in the encrypted string are case-insensitive.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的号码。

若Mask取值为NORMAL，该字段为11位手机号码。
若Mask取值为MD5，该字段为32位加密字符串。
若Mask取值为SHA256，该字段为64位加密字符串。

<notice>加密字符串中字母不区分大小写。></notice>
parameters.name: input_number

parameters.help_en:
The encryption method of the phone number. Valid values:

NORMAL: not encrypted.
MD5
SHA256
parameters.help_zh:
号码的加密方式。取值：

NORMAL：不加密
MD5
SHA256
parameters.name: mask

parameters.help_en:
The time in the format of yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. This time is the registration time of the mobile user on the business side. If the registration time is later than the carrier's number assignment time, the number is not a recycled number. Otherwise, the result indicates that the number is recycled.

If a single number has been assigned multiple times on the carrier side, the system uses the last assignment time on the carrier side as the basis for judgment.
The registration time must be later than 1970-01-01 00:00:00
parameters.help_zh:
时间，格式必须为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss。该时间为手机用户在业务侧的注册时间。如果注册时间在运营商放号时间之后，则表示该号码不是二次号，否则返回结果是二次号。

若单个号码在运营商侧存在多次放号的情况，系统将以最后一次在运营商侧的放号时间作为判断依据。
注册时间必须为1970-01-01 00:00:00之后的时间
parameters.name: start_time

Code.description_en:
The request status code. Valid values:

OK: The request is successful.

PortabilityNumberNotSupported: The ported number is not supported.
RequestNumberNotSupported: China Broadnet numbers (starting with 192), virtual carrier numbers, and other numbers that carriers do not support for queries are not supported.

RequestFrequencyLimit: Due to carrier restrictions, repeated high-frequency queries on the same number within a short period are prohibited. If this error code is returned, try again later.

You are charged only when Code is OK and VerifyResult is not 0. For billing details, see [China Number Service pricing]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154751.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。取值：

OK：请求成功。

PortabilityNumberNotSupported：不支持的携号转网号码。
RequestNumberNotSupported：不支持中国广电号码（192开头）和虚拟运营商和其他运营商不支持查询的号码。

RequestFrequencyLimit：因运营商限制，禁止在短时间内高频对同一个号码进行反复查询，如返回此错误码，请您稍后再试。

当Code取值为OK，且VerifyResult值不为0时计费，计费文档请参见[号码百科定价]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154751.html）

Carrier.description_en:
The carrier. Valid values:

CMCC: China Mobile.
CUCC: China Unicom.
CTCC: China Telecom.

The carrier to which the number currently belongs is returned. If the number has been ported, the carrier after porting is returned
Carrier.description_zh:
运营商。取值：

CMCC：中国移动。
CUCC：中国联通。
CTCC：中国电信。

返回当前号码的归属运营商，如果该号码存在携号转网的情况，则返回携号转网后的运营商

VerifyResult.description_en:
The query result. Valid values:

0: Unable to determine.
1: The number is recycled.
2: The number is not recycled.
3: The number has been deregistered.
4: Unknown. The number has been transferred to another owner
VerifyResult.description_zh:
查询结果。取值：

0：无法判断。
1：是二次放号。
2：不是二次放号。
3：号码已注销。
4：未知，号码存在过户行为

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

RequestId.description_en: The common parameter. A unique ID is returned for each request and can be used to locate and troubleshoot issues. The ID is active for troubleshooting purposes
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求返回的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
